[11] Query MTG rules - look up a rule or a card first; reply: ACTION 11 'search phrase', 'another phrase'

Both opponents have no creatures, so all attacks are unblocked. I should attack with everything. But which target? Attacking Elven Empire triggers Curse of Disturbance giving me a Zombie token. Attacking Wade doesn't. So I want to attack Elven Empire with everything to maximize the Curse trigger (one Zombie per attack trigger, not per creature — actually "Whenever enchanted player is attacked" triggers once per attack declaration, so only one Zombie regardless of number of attackers). 
 
Actually the Curse triggers once when enchanted player is attacked. So attacking Elven Empire with all gives one Zombie token. Attacking Wade gives no token. 
 
Both have no blockers, so I should send everything at one player. Elven Empire at 34, Wade at 29. Wade is lower. But attacking Elven Empire gives a Zombie token. Hmm, one Zombie token is minor. 
 
Actually, let me think about spreading damage. Both opponents have no creatures, so all damage is free. I want to kill them eventually. Wade is lower at 29. But Elven Empire has more life and is rebuilding. 
 
Total power: Butcher 5, Falkenrath 2, Zombie 2, Zombie 2, Vampire 1 = 12 damage. If all at Elven Empire: 34->22, plus a Zombie token. If all at Wade: 29->17. 
 
Hmm. I think attacking Elven Empire is better to get the Curse token and because Elven Empire is the bigger long-term threat (elf swarm). Actually Wade has Kalemne in stack (suspended) and is a giant deck.  
 
Let me just attack Elven Empire with everything to get the token and pressure the higher-life opponent. Actually, spreading might be better to keep both pressured. But no blockers means no risk. I'll send all at Elven Empire for the token. 
 
Wait, actually the Curse triggers once regardless. Let me reconsider: is it better to hit Wade who is lower? Wade at 29, Elven Empire at 34. Neither is close to dead.  
 
I'll attack Elven Empire with all to get the Zombie token (extra body) and pressure. Actually, let me split: send some at each? No benefit. The Curse token only comes from attacking Elven Empire. 
 
I'll attack all at Elven Empire.
